authority: #K2-348 W2' step 1: frames layer (four corner 6x6 squares as HARD placement inputs) + the constructive criterion baseline
constructive_criterion: each square must contain NO copper and NO hole BY CONSTRUCTION (not sculpted); measured here as: tracks/vias/pads/zone-fill hits == 0

summary.square_convention: bbox = [x0, y0, x1, y1]; hit test uses x0<=x<=x1 and y0<=y<=y1 (R884 fix: the first version mis-indexed the bbox)
summary.note: H4's square is measured at its frames-first TARGET position; today's board has H4 at (140.8,76.8) so its own keepout square is elsewhere (M-ENG-HOLE-KEEPOUT-STALE, H4 branch)

crisp_findings.1_three_corners_have_NO_routed_copper: H3_TL / H2_TR / H1_BL each contain 0 tracks, 0 vias, 0 pads - only copper POURS (GND/MCU_VDD/P3V3/12V_IN fills). So three of four corners need NO re-route at all: enforcing the hole keepout at pour time (the keepout already says copperpour not_allowed -> a zone REFILL with the keepout in place) should vacate them by construction.
crisp_findings.2_H4_is_the_ONLY_corner_with_routed_copp: exactly 2 tracks + 2 vias, and the nets are exactly PCIE_DN4_N (2) and PCIE_DN5_P (2) - the two lanes this whole episode has been about. Nothing else lives there.
crisp_findings.3_holes_are_already_at_the_corner_positi: H3/H2/H1 landed in l14 and H4 (140.8,76.8) falls inside its frames-first square; the mechanical frame is therefore nearly in place - the work left is the COPPER, and for H4 that means the FAN-OUT DIRECTION, not surgery.
crisp_findings.4_hence_W2_prime_is_smaller_than_it_look: frames-first: (a) refill the zones with the four keepouts in force (constructive pour exclusion) for the three clean corners; (b) re-plan the DN4_N/DN5_P escape direction at the PLACEMENT level so the bottom-right corner is never routed into; (c) then all four squares pass constructively.

method_note: census = point-in-polygon sampling of every filled zone outline (0.5 mm grid) + segment sampling (0.05 mm) for tracks + exact tests for vias/pads/holes; read-only
